description: Operating at the 30,000 foot level with flexibility, #flexibility #selflove #maturity
transcript: I prioritize flexibility, but within that I'm very aware, I'm very clear about everything that's going on around me, everything exists in tandem, everything is happening simultaneously, everything is interchangeable, everything around me impacts my internal ecosystem. I can't always give this the same amount of energy that I give this, flexibility allows me to lead and guide from a new perspective, also with enough wisdom and information to think clearly, to think logically, to think at the 30,000 foot level.
